title: Pain and boredom
src: Schopenhauer, The World as Will and Representation, par. 57
idea: Schopenhauer said life swings like a pendulum between pain and boredom. Wanting hurts, and getting it soon goes flat.
apply: When a goal is reached and the glow fades, expect it. Line up the next meaningful thing before boredom arrives.
remind: Expect the swing. Plan the next worthwhile thing.
who: Ravi, who just got the promotion he wanted for years.

scenes.nar: Ravi wanted a promotion for two years. He finally gets it, and three weeks later, it already feels flat.
Schopenhauer described life as a pendulum between pain and boredom. When we want something it hurts, and when we get it, it goes flat.
So he expects the swing. Before the boredom arrives, he picks the next challenge, the one that is worth the wanting.
Three months on, he leads a new project and mentors two juniors. The flat stretch never arrives.
